products.product_description: Ground Cumin, sold under Aunt Patty's brand, packed in 1lb. pack, 5 lb. pack, 25 lb. pack, and 50 lb. pack. Product is labeled in part, "***Handled in a facility that processes and/or repacks peanuts, soy, wheat, tree nuts, and dairy products.***" Item #12650 is for 1 lb. Item #12648 is for 5 lb. Item #12651 is for 25 lb. Item #12649 is for 50 lb.
products.code_info: Lot code for 1 lb. pack: MG0074013; Lot codes for 5 lb. pack: MG0076070, MG0078195, AND MG0074282; Lot codes for 25 lb. pack: MG0076503, MG0077469, AND MG0073506; Lot codes for 50 lb. pack: MG0076762 AND MG0073750;
products.reason_for_recall: Ground Cumin is recalled because it contains more than 25 ppm of peanut protein.
